decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed change of use to a combined ATM and payphone would be compatible with the retail appearance and character of the area, and would not harm adjoining businesses or result in conditions harmful to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area. The proposal therefore complies with UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), T.2.2 (Pedestrian Safety and Security) and T.2.1 (Pedestrian Access) and the Supplementary Planning Guidance policies
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The ATM shall have a receipts disposal facility incorporated within it.
Condition : 5 - The ATM and public call box shall be removed within six months when no longer operational
description: Change of use to form ATM and payphone.
